title: Sleepy bumblebee
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='38' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#cfe9ff' transform='rotate(-25 36 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='38' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#cfe9ff' transform='rotate(25 64 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='40' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#a9d6ff' transform='rotate(-25 37 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='40' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#a9d6ff' transform='rotate(25 63 40)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M30 52 Q50 62 70 52' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 66 Q50 76 72 66' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M50 84 L46 94 L54 94 Z' fill='#8a6a1f'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='15' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M44 26 Q40 16 34 14' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 26 Q60 16 66 14' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='14' r='3' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='14' r='3' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <!-- sleepy eyes (closed) -->
  <path d='M41 38 Q45 42 49 38' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 38 Q59 42 63 38' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 51 54 48' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
